_comment: Build recipe for each region model. Kept separate from src/data/atlas3d.ts
because this is pipeline input (what to extract, how hard to decimate),
while atlas3d.ts is runtime data (what the app loads and maps).
'knownUnmapped' lists clinical entries we have deliberately not mapped to a
mesh, with a reason. Those render as '3D view not available' rather than
being pointed at an approximate neighbour.
'excludeStructures' MUST be honoured: those models are NonCommercial or unknown-licence and cannot ship in a CC BY-SA build. See LICENSES-3D.md section 1.

knownUnmapped.reason: Absent from the Z-Anatomy source model (only palmaris longus is present). Verified across all objects and suffixes, commit 4169f1e. Shown as "3D view not available" rather than pointed at a neighbouring structure.

regions.notes: Right limb only. No decimation needed: raw export is 4.4 MB / 908 KB after Draco, well inside the 8 MB budget.
